title: Samsung, SK Reportedly to Invest $1.3 Trillion Over 10 Years
title_zh: 据报道三星和SK将在10年内投资1.3万亿美元
summary: (Bloomberg) -- South Korea’s Samsung Group and SK Group are poised to announce as much as 2,000 trillion won ($1.3 trillion) of investments over the next decade as part of President Lee Jae Myung’s flagship industrial strategy, Korea Economic Daily reported Monday.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——据《韩国经济日报》周一报道，作为韩国总统李在明旗舰产业战略的一部分，韩国三星集团和 SK 集团准备宣布在未来十年进行高达 2000 万亿韩元（1.3 万亿美元）的投资。

title: Stock market today: S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow futures climb as a halt to US-Iranian attacks is called
title_zh: 今日股市：随着美伊袭击停止，标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克指数和道琼斯指数期货上涨
summary: The major gauges advanced as peace talks between Iran and the US were broached.
summary_zh: 随着伊朗和美国之间的和平谈判的展开，主要指标上涨。

title: 'We don't view this as a bubble' that will pop soon: Wall Street weighs surging AI costs on stock market rally
title_zh: “我们不认为这是一个很快就会破灭的泡沫”：华尔街在股市上涨中权衡人工智能成本飙升
summary: Wall Street analysts told Yahoo Finance that Micron's earnings proved AI demand remains strong.
summary_zh: 华尔街分析师告诉雅虎财经，美光科技的财报证明人工智能需求仍然强劲。

title: Slate's CEO on launching a $25K EV and why it's 'fun to have a contrarian point of view'
title_zh: Slate 首席执行官谈推出一款售价 2.5 万美元的电动汽车，以及为什么“持有逆向观点很有趣”
summary: A new car for under $25,000 is rare enough in America these days, but one that happens to be an EV pickup is a downright unicorn. That's the bet Slate is making with its first EV, and CEO Peter Faricy is not shy about singing its praises.
summary_zh: 如今，一辆售价低于 25,000 美元的新车在美国已经很少见了，但如果是电动皮卡，那就是彻头彻尾的独角兽。这是 Slate 对其首款电动汽车的押注，首席执行官彼得·法里西 (Peter Faricy) 并不羞于赞扬它。

title: AI jitters meet a jobs report and falling oil prices: What to watch this week
title_zh: 人工智能的紧​​张情绪与就业报告和油价下跌相结合：本周值得关注的内容
summary: After a roller-coaster week in the markets, thanks to flip-flopping sentiment about AI spending, investors will get plenty more action on the calendar as we enter jobs week.
summary_zh: 在市场经历了过山车般的一周之后，由于对人工智能支出的情绪反复无常，随着我们进入就业周，投资者将在日历上采取更多行动。

title: Google limits Meta’s use of its Gemini AI models, FT reports
title_zh: 据英国《金融时报》报道，谷歌限制 Meta 使用其 Gemini AI 模型
summary: June 28 (Reuters) - Google has put limits on Meta’s use of its Gemini AI models after the social media company sought more computing capacity than the rival tech group could provide, the Financial
summary_zh: 6 月 28 日（路透社）——在社交媒体公司寻求比竞争对手科技集团所能提供的更多计算能力后，谷歌对 Meta 使用其 Gemini AI 模型设置了限制。
